units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:2">Snh. VI, 2</cite> <he>היה ר׳ מבית וכ׳</he> when the culprit arrived at a distance of about ten cubits from the place of execution.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:1">Pes. IX, 1</cite> <he>מי … או בדרך ר׳</he> he who (on the fourteenth day of Nisan) was unclean or on a distant journey (<cite ref="Numbers 9:10">Num. IX, 10</cite>). Ib. 2 <he>לפיכך … מפני שרחוקה ודאי וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. 93ᵇ <he>רחוק</he>) therefore is the Hé (of <he>רחוקה</he>, Num. l. c.) dotted, not that it necessarily be distant (that he be really far away), but that he be outside of the Temple court (and unable to enter in time); Y. ib. 36ᵈ <he>ה״א … איש ר׳ ואין דרך ר׳</he> the Hé is dotted to intimate that the man is at a distance <he>(רחוק</he>), not that the way be far; a. fr.—<he>שמועה ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U01441"><he>שְׁמוּעָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>רְחוֹקִים</he>, <he>רְחוֹקִין</he>; <he>רְחוֹקוֹת</he>. Sabb. 182ᵃ <he>קרובים נעשו ר׳</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01926"><he>קָרוֹב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01097"><he>סָמַךְ</he></cite>; a. fr.
